snippet.title: Vartio | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Vartio now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639120/Vartio/

Patrol a haunted forest as a lone medieval guard in this short psychological horror experience. Leave the safety of your watchtower, listen for threats in the dark, and uncover what's lurking beyond the trees—before paranoia consumes you.
